title: Prevalence and Characterization of Persistent Dyspnea After Hospitalization
brief_summary: The investigators aim to make an overview of persistent dyspnea at the end of an hospitalization for a respiratory disease using an actual tool, the Multidisciplinary Dyspnea Profile questionnaire.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age over 18 years old
* Able to respond the questionnaire
* Presenting at admission a dyspnea over 3/10 on numerical analogic scale
* Admitted for a respiratory cause

Exclusion Criteria:

* cognitive impairment
* aphasia
* no french-speaking person
study_population: Every consecutive patient admitted to hospitalization for a respiratory cause having a significant dyspnea
